acceptance: scripts/run-tests.mjs runs segments in a bounded async worker pool (ADLC_TEST_CONCURRENCY default Math.min(os.availableParallelism(), 6)) with isolated per-child TMPDIR, deterministic buffered output, and excludes packages/autopilot/test/spec-coverage.test.mjs from pass 1 so it executes once inside autopilot AC gate.

packages/hollow-test/lib/gate-plan.mjs maps all scripts/*.mjs files, includes plugins/<name>/hooks/test on plugin root changes, and guarantees >= 1 mutant quota per file; hollow-test/lib/runner.mjs scrubs ADLC_MANIFEST_KEY via sanitizeCandidateEnv.

hollow-test generates mutants before baseline execution (0-mutant comment/doc diffs exit fast), supports --skip-baseline (passed by mutation-gate.mjs after its single measured baseline), runs per-file mapped test commands when provided, and reuses a persistent syntax-check-typescript stdio worker per run.
packages/core/lib/mutate.mjs masks string/template literals before regex mutation, adds ?? and if (!expr) -> if (expr) operators, and replaces single offset spans instead of /g.
packages/behavior-diff captures normalized HTTP headers and bounded bodies and performs full shared-prefix array diffs.

scripts/preflight-fast.mjs runs sub-second static gates (rails-guard-ci, scan-findings-ledger, guard-findings-ledger-append-only, check-reviewer-directed-comments) before run-tests.mjs and mutation-gate.mjs.
